why: I checked each of the four verifier checks' PASS and FAIL conditions against its expect line. Check 1 asks only that `--shout Ada` and `--shout 'Grace Hopper'` print the greeting in upper case. It fails on errors, empty output or lower-case text, all of which the words cover. Check 2 compares the output without --shout against the merge base, which is what "unchanged" means. Check 3 asks that docs/index.md "mentions the `--shout` flag and says what it does". Saying what the flag does is a fair reading of "documents". Check 4 can't fetch the live page, so it checks the two things the published page needs: the workflow still publishes docs/ on push, and docs/index.md lists --shout. Both are needed for the expect line to hold after merge. The stricter checks (`npm test` and new tests, the flag placed after the name, the usage error with exit 2) all sit under "Advisory (not pass/fail)". No PASS or FAIL condition goes beyond what its expect line's words require.
